intro: A Saskatchewan baritone who sings cowboy and prairie songs.
story: Colter Wall was born in Swift Current, Saskatchewan, and worked cattle before music. He played Pickathon in the summer of 2018, a few months before Songs of the Plains, produced by Dave Cobb for Thirty Tigers, came out in October and landed on Rolling Stone's list of the year's best country and Americana albums. Western Swing & Waltzes came in 2020 and Little Songs in 2023. Memories and Empties, on RCA, followed in 2025.
artist_reel_line: Memories and Empties, on RCA, came in 2025.

intro: A Melbourne songwriter who co-founded Milk! Records.
story: Jen Cloher is a Melbourne songwriter who co-founded Milk! Records in 2012. Their self-titled fourth album came out in 2017, mixed at Wilco's Loft studio in Chicago with Courtney Barnett on guitar, and Bandcamp Daily made it Album of the Day. They played Pickathon in 2018. I Am the River, The River Is Me followed in 2023, and they have since launched a podcast of Māori and First Nations music interviews.
artist_reel_line: I Am the River, The River Is Me came out in 2023.

intro: A solo songwriter who co-founded the Be Good Tanyas.
story: Frazey Ford co-founded the Be Good Tanyas in 1999 before going solo with Obadiah on Nettwerk in 2010, the year she first came to Pickathon. Indian Ocean, recorded in Memphis with Al Green's Hi Rhythm Section in 2014, made the Polaris Prize longlist. She returned in 2018, and U Kin B the Sun followed on Arts & Crafts in February 2020.
artist_reel_line: U kin B the Sun came out on Arts & Crafts in 2020.
